episodes.title: Offermakaren del 1
episodes.summary: Stockholm police officer Hanna arrives in Åre to unwind but soon joins the search effort for a girl who went missing on her way home from a party.

episodes.title: Offermakaren del 2
episodes.summary: Daniel discovers Hanna's secret, while her cleaner Zuhra is concealing something of her own. Annika and Bosse throw a mulled-wine night.

episodes.title: Offermakaren del 3
episodes.summary: Hanna gets important information from Ebba. Amanda's father is sure he knows what happened. A clue from Zuhra brings everything to a head.

episodes.title: Dalskuggan del 1
episodes.summary: A couple of months after solving Amanda's case, a new crime shocks Åre just as Daniel prepares to go on parental leave.

episodes.title: Dalskuggan del 2
episodes.summary: The police search for Rebecka and look to solve Johan's murder. Hanna and Daniel receive surprising news that sends them in a new direction.
